timothy1.6.p1.b1.text: All who are under the yoke of slavery should regard their masters as fully worthy of honor, …

timothy1.6.p1.b2.text: … but should serve them all the more, since those receiving their good service are beloved believers.

timothy1.6.p1.b3.text: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,

timothy1.6.p1.b4.text: he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and semantics, …

timothy1.6.p2.b5.text: Of course, godliness with contentment is great gain.

timothy1.6.p2.b6.text: For we brought nothing into the world, so we cannot carry anything out of it. But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.

timothy1.6.p2.b7.text: For the love of money is the root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many sorrows.

timothy1.6.p3.b8.text: But you, O man of God, flee from these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

timothy1.6.p3.b9.text: Fight the good fight of the faith. Take hold of the eternal life …

timothy1.6.p3.b10.text: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who made the good confession in His testimony before Pontius Pilate:

timothy1.6.p4.b11.text: Keep this commandment without stain or reproach until the appearance of our Lord Jesus Christ,

timothy1.6.p4.b12.text: which the blessed and only Sovereign One—the King of kings and Lord of lords—will bring about in His own time. He alone is immortal and dwells in unapproachable light. No one has ever seen Him, nor can anyone see Him.

timothy1.6.p4.b13.text: To Him be honor and eternal dominion! Amen.

timothy1.6.p5.b14.text: Instruct those who are rich in the present age not to be conceited and not to put their hope in the uncertainty of wealth, but in God, who richly provides all things for us to enjoy.

timothy1.6.p5.b15.text: Instruct them to do good, to be rich in good works, and to be generous and ready to share,

timothy1.6.p5.b16.text: treasuring up for themselves a firm foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of that which is truly life.

timothy1.6.p6.b17.text: O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you.

timothy1.6.p6.b18.text: Avoid irreverent, empty chatter and the opposing arguments of so-called “knowledge,” which some have professed and thus swerved away from the faith.
